purpose: P4 step 3: the in-house analysis at 24 kHz / 180 (k1_poly24 output) against the current 12.8 kHz / 96 analysis (k1_asrc24 Emotiscope profile output), same PCM, host probe tests/host/p4_analysis24_probe.cpp
frozen_before_results: Written before the 24 kHz InhouseAudio path or its probe exist; no 24 kHz feature has been computed. Never regenerated. If a gate fails: report FAIL, do not flash.

inputs.boom_song: BOOM song file at the device-calibrated gain 1.155 (scripts/p3_agc_trace.py source_pcm), 40 kHz nominal into both resamplers
inputs.boom_room: BOOM iPhone room recording at the device-calibrated gain (scripts/p3_agc_trace.py), 40 kHz nominal
inputs.dopex_room: Dopex iPhone room recording including the post-roll silence, same calibration method
inputs.alignment: both paths publish one generation per 7.5 ms; generations are paired by time with a lag search of -3..+3 generations, chosen once per input on raw_rms and then held for every stream

i_bins_below_5120hz.stream: raw GDFT normalised magnitude per bin (InhouseAudio raw frame), every generation 0-75 s
i_bins_below_5120hz.bins: every bin whose target frequency is below 5,120 Hz (0.8 x the 12.8 kHz Nyquist); bins from 5,120 Hz to 6,400 Hz are reported only (the 12.8 kHz anti-alias transition band)
i_bins_below_5120hz.pass: Pearson r over time >= 0.90 for every such bin AND the median over those bins >= 0.97, on boom_song and boom_room

ii_bins_above_6400hz.bins: every bin whose target frequency is above 6,400 Hz (zero at 12.8 kHz by construction)
ii_bins_above_6400hz.pass_a_nonzero: each such bin's mean magnitude over 28-75 s (boom_song) >= 0.001 x the mean magnitude of the bins below 5,120 Hz
ii_bins_above_6400hz.pass_b_real: Pearson r >= 0.60 between the sum of those bins' magnitudes and a 6.5-11 kHz band RMS envelope of the 40 kHz source on the same 7.5 ms grid (best lag within +/-30 ms), boom_song 0-75 s

iii_level_streams.pass: on boom_song, boom_room and dopex_room: raw_rms median ratio (24k / 12.8k) within 0.90-1.15 and Spearman rho >= 0.95; vu_level the same; peak_scaled Spearman rho >= 0.90 and median |difference| <= 0.10; silence flag agreement >= 99% of generations; on dopex_room the first post-roll silence-flag generation within +/-0.5 s of the 12.8 kHz path's

iv_tempo.stream: board-1 (Tempo) in-house tempo_bpm, tempo demand on
iv_tempo.pass: |median 24k - median 12.8k| <= 2 BPM over BOOM 33-43 s, on boom_song and boom_room

planted_faults_must_fail.i: 24 kHz path told the source is 5% faster than it is (k1_poly24_set_rate x1.05)
planted_faults_must_fail.ii: 24 kHz path fed a linear upsample of the 12.8 kHz output instead of the source (no real content above 6.4 kHz)

unchanged: The donor Emotiscope analysis stays on the 12.8 kHz / 64 output, bit-exact; checked separately by comparing the donor hop stream before and after (max |difference| = 0).
